desc: Derive the necessary condition that \(R\) must be even.
Characterize impossible pure-color cases and provide pure-red/pure-blue cycle constructions.
Replace the broken mixed-color blue-segment construction with a correct construction for every even \(R\ge2,\ B\ge1\).
Build the red return path with exactly \(R-1\) edges and no duplicated vertices.
Audit all constructions for edge move types, exact piece counts, distinct vertices, and coordinate bounds.
Exhaustively validate small cases and rerun the sample tests.
